comment: The init wizard asks for every environment variable the plan needs, optional ones included, and later commands ask only for required secrets that aren't set yet. `askSecrets` is now `askEnv`. Plans no longer list add-ons the project already has. Apply retries Windows file locks for longer, including when it releases its lock, so a held lock file no longer blocks the next command. A saved plan records the template package versions it was made with, and `init --plan` loads exactly those, so a newer release never runs before the plan is checked.
